title: Local SEO Content Assistant
businessOutcomes: Better chances of being found in local searches.
summary: Generate location-specific blog posts, service pages, and FAQ content optimized for local search using your real customer language from reviews.
businessProblem: Local businesses need location-specific content to rank in 'near me' searches, but owners don't know what to write about or how to incorporate the keywords customers actually use.
outcome: Monthly batch of 2–4 local SEO content pieces: service area pages, FAQ posts, and blog articles using real customer language from reviews — ready for website publishing.
expectedOutcomes: Monthly batch of 2–4 local SEO content pieces: service area pages, FAQ posts, and blog articles using real customer language from reviews — ready for website publishing.
whoItsFor: Local service businesses competing for Google Maps and organic search visibility in a specific city or region — plumbers, dentists, lawyers, restaurants.
aiInputs: Customer review language (how customers describe your services)
Competitor content gaps (topics they rank for that you don't)
Local events and seasonal search trends
aiOutputs: Service area page draft (e.g., 'Plumbing Services in [Neighborhood]')
FAQ page with 10–15 questions matching 'near me' search patterns
Blog post draft using customer review language as social proof
Meta title and description per page
noCodeTools: ChatGPT with business info and review exports
Surfer SEO or Clearscope with AI writing
lowCodeTools: n8n: monthly review pull → OpenAI content batch → Google Doc
Claude with review analysis for content generation
customBuildStack: Review API pull for customer language extraction
OpenAI for content generation with local SEO prompt templates
Output to CMS via API or content doc for manual publish
implementationSteps: List target service areas and primary services for SEO
Pull 50+ reviews and extract common phrases customers use
Research 'near me' keyword patterns for your services + city
Generate content batch: 1 service area page, 1 FAQ, 1 blog post
Review for factual accuracy and local relevance before publishing
Track rankings monthly and adjust content topics based on movement
systemBehavior: Runs monthly or on-demand for content planning
Incorporates real review language — not generic AI phrasing
Generates drafts only — human reviews before publishing
Creates unique content per service area (no duplicate city pages)
Includes meta tags and suggested internal links
risks: AI-generated local pages can be thin content if not customized enough
Google may penalize mass-produced location pages without unique value
Incorrect local references (wrong neighborhoods, outdated business info)
Review quotes in content need permission on some platforms
